_comment: What this gate emits against each tree here. Machine-readable because prose in GATE.md is not a declaration: a stated count nothing checks drifts the moment a case is added, which four of these had done.

cases: .obsidian/core-plugins.json: declared as tracked reader configuration but is not tracked
.obsidian/workspace.json: per-person workspace state or cache is tracked
.obsidian/cache/state.bin: lives under declared-untracked reader path '.obsidian/cache' and is tracked
.obsidian/app.json: useMarkdownLinks is False, must be True
